title: BPW-2026-0537
text:
[CONSENT ITEM]
BPW-2026-0537
BOE
CD 9
BID REJECTION – AFFORDABLE HOUSING AND SUSTAINABLE COMMUNITIES ROUND 5 PARKVIEW SUSTAINABLE TRANSPORTATION INFRASTRUCTURE AND TRANSPORTATION RELATED AMENITIES IMPROVEMENTS
Recommending the Board:
REJECT the sole bid for the project and that the City Engineer return to the Board to re-advertise the project at a later date.
(W.O.: E1908904)
summary: The Board is asked to reject the only bid on the Parkview sustainable transportation and transportation amenities improvement project, so the City Engineer can re-advertise it later.
